dedupe_keys.name: train metro and light rail station entries and exits data

description: Train, Metro, and Light Rail Station Entries and Exits Data is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. The counts of train, metro, and light rail station entries and exits are derived from samples representing 'typical days' and monthly data. ‘Typical day’ data is only available from 2016 to 2023. All data is based on OPAL Transaction data. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are Opal, TPA, entry, exit, metro. It offers 4 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
